If the first verified persisted training action is SFT, at most one later verified training action is needed to determine whether the permitted one-stage SFT warm-up transitions to RL.
If a second verified training action is SFT, clean PRE headroom is impossible and paid expansion stops immediately.
Any support/instrument failure or provider model-identity drift stops the resume without a fresh restart.
